producer.audio_source: repository test-audio recordings, PCM float32 mono at 48000 Hz

targets.scope: Starting design targets, not validated acceptance limits. Error targets apply to scenes with source reference range up to 50 m; mixed-range tables are indicative only.

spec.name: Separate noise-first point-of-interest attribution prototype
spec.registered_before: Any attribution fixture or mixture-study outcomes
spec.nodes: Evenly spaced on a25m radius ring, heading0, height1.5m, flat4_100 nominal geometry.
spec.audio: Independent Rademacher white-noise clips from mulberry32((seed+10000+1000*poi_index)>>>0), sample=-1 when draw<0.5 else+1; four seconds at48kHz, source start1s; semantic POI names are not realistic traffic/music/HVAC recordings. Render5.5s, no buildings/ground/reflections/diffraction; original realism off/on hardware/noise profiles only.
spec.source_level: Nominal total70dBSPL at receptor[0,0,1.5], per-source1m level=70+10log10(recipe_share*distance_to_receptor_squared). Actual reference powers include propagation filtering, so recipe is not substituted for scored truth.
spec.observations: First mic per node; mean-square power over[2,4]s minus measured quiet power over[0,0.5]s, clamped nonnegative. Estimator receives first-mic nominal coordinates from declared geometry, POI coordinates and levels, never component audio, source powers or true mic positions.
spec.estimator: Nonnegative least squares with inverse-square transfer, enumerating all active subsets of three declared POIs. Require at least three nodes and full-rank normalized transfer matrix (Gram pivot tolerance1e-8); otherwise shares/error are null with an explicit reason. Report receptor energy shares, not emission-power fractions.
spec.localiser: Run the unchanged measured pipeline on every mixture. Associate final fixes to nearest declared POI within10m for diagnostics only. All positions are declared map priors, not inferred truth; no reliable-fix claim or localisation-based position refinement.
spec.truth: Isolated source-only, noise-free single-mic renders at the receptor; energy over[2,4]s. Twelve unique seed/recipe/source renders, reused across node-count and realism conditions because reference geometry/physics is identical. Finite-mixture cross terms are not attributed; independent-source energy additivity is an assumption.
spec.metrics: Mean absolute share error across three POIs, percentage points; per-POI signed error; nonidentifiable rate; actual fix/association counts. Preserve two-node nulls. Equal complete seed/recipe population per node-count/realism condition.
spec.intervals: Exact two observed seed-cluster values and their range; no reliable population95%CI from two clusters. No ranking from partial data.
spec.unit_fixtures: Three sources with known nonnegative powers on noncollinear3/6-node geometries recover noiseless shares;2nodes and rank-deficient geometries return explicit null; invalid/nonfinite inputs throw.
spec.assumptions: Every POI location is known; stationary uncorrelated point sources, inverse-square transfer, measured stationary background, no unknown contributors, ground or occlusion. All are placeholders. Not a validated road/bar percentage product and not a localiser replacement.
